selectionGuide.description: A three-person street scene depicts someone abandoning attention to an existing commitment for a tempting newcomer.
bestFor: an established choice being neglected for an attractive novelty
shifting attention or priorities despite an existing commitment

mechanics.visual: The boyfriend's turned gaze links the tempting newcomer to his choice, while the girlfriend's reaction marks the neglected commitment.
mechanics.text: Label other-woman with the novelty, boyfriend with the tempted agent, and girlfriend with the existing option; short noun phrases read cleanly.
